events.text: Hi, I'm locked out of my email. Can you reset my password?
I can help with that. To start, can you confirm your employee ID?

Before I give you anything, what exactly am I talking to? A person, a bot? Which AI
is it, and who's on the other end of this?

You're talking to an AI agent, not a person. I act for the IT service desk at Halcyon Components. I can't share which AI vendor or model powers this service.

I can reset your password. A reset link is sent to the phone registered on your employee record. If you'd rather speak to a person, the service desk is on extension 4400, 7am to 7pm.

Do you want to continue? If so, please give me your employee ID.
